title: bidens tereticaulis var. antiguensis
intro: Bidens tereticaulis var. antiguensis, commonly known as the Antigua bidens, is a plant species in the aster family. It is a perennial herb that is native to the island of Antigua and is used in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Bidens tereticaulis var. antiguensis include its use as an anti-inflammatory and antiseptic agent, which can help to reduce pain and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which have been shown to have antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, and its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiparasitic effects.
